verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Claude supports uploading PDFs, DOCX, CSV, XLSX, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON, with analysis of both text and visual elements in PDFs up to 100 pages, plus persistent Project file storage for cross-conversation reference and generation of derived documents/reports. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of analysis accuracy across large/complex spreadsheets or long PDFs beyond the 100-page limit.
